name: Exp_ColorHMA_StDev
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorHMA_StDev indicator, which is a Hull Moving Average enhanced with standard deviation bands. It opens and closes buy/sell positions using three signal modes: point signals from colored dots, direct trend direction from the HMA line, or disabled signals entirely.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorHMA_StDev指标进行交易，该指标是带有标准差通道的Hull移动平均线。它使用三种信号模式（点信号、直接趋势方向、禁用）来开仓和平仓买卖仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Hull移动平均线(HMA)结合标准差通道，属于趋势跟踪型策略。入场条件有两种模式：点信号模式通过检查指标缓冲区3/5（买入）或2/4（卖出）是否非空值来确认信号；直接模式通过HMA线的方向变化来判断趋势转折，买入信号为V形反转（先降后升），卖出信号为倒V形反转（先升后降）。出场条件同样支持点信号和直接模式，直接模式下买入平仓条件为HMA线下降，卖出平仓条件为HMA线上升。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持多种资金管理模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的保证金或固定手数。风险控制依赖固定的止损和止盈参数，默认止损1000点、止盈2000点，并设有滑点容差参数Deviation_。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a Hull Moving Average (HMA) combined with standard deviation channels, classifying it as a trend-following system. Entry conditions support two modes: the POINT mode checks if indicator buffers 3/5 (buy) or 2/4 (sell) contain non-empty values to confirm signal dots; the DIRECT mode detects trend reversals via HMA line direction changes — a V-shaped bottom for buy entries and an inverted V-shaped top for sell entries. Exit conditions also support both modes: in DIRECT mode, a buy position closes when the HMA line declines, and a sell position closes when it rises. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting multiple money management approaches including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin/balance, or fixed lot sizing. Risk control relies on fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points) parameters, with a slippage tolerance parameter (Deviation_). The EA uses a new bar detection mechanism to avoid processing signals on every tick, and employs a Recount flag for error recovery when indicator data is unavailable.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter, lots or ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（自由保证金/余额/扣除亏损后/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots, balance percentage, etc.)

parameters.name: BuyPosOpen
parameters.description: 买入开仓信号模式（点信号/直接方向/禁用）
parameters.description_en: Buy entry signal mode (dot signal/direct direction/disabled)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Close long positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions on signal reversal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号计算使用的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Signal bar index (0 for current bar)

pros: 信号模式灵活，开仓和平仓可独立选择点信号或趋势方向模式，适应不同交易风格
使用Hull移动平均线，相比普通MA具有更低的延迟和更好的平滑性
内置新K线检测机制，避免逐Tick重复计算信号，减少不必要的交易操作
支持多种资金管理模式，提供灵活的仓位控制选项
标准差通道提供额外的波动率参考，有助于判断市场状态
pros_en: Flexible signal modes allow independent configuration of entry and exit logic (point signals vs. trend direction), adapting to different trading styles
Uses Hull Moving Average which has lower latency and better smoothing compared to standard moving averages
Built-in new bar detection mechanism avoids per-tick signal recalculation, reducing unnecessary trading operations
Supports multiple money management modes, providing flexible position sizing options
Standard deviation channels provide additional volatility context for market state assessment
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动性（ATR）动态调整，在不同行情下可能不合适
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下尤其是小周期交易可能导致不利成交
没有持仓数量限制，在强趋势中可能连续开仓导致过度暴露
依赖自定义指标ColorHMA_StDev，指标文件缺失时EA将无法初始化
代码注释为乱码（编码问题），降低了代码可读性和可维护性
cons_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit in points do not adapt to market volatility (no ATR-based adjustment), which may be inappropriate under varying market conditions
No spread filter — high spread environments can lead to unfavorable fills, especially on lower timeframes
No position count limit — consecutive entries in strong trends may lead to excessive exposure
Depends on the custom ColorHMA_StDev indicator — the EA fails to initialize if the indicator file is missing
Code comments are garbled (encoding issue), reducing code readability and maintainability
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动性自适应调整止损止盈距离
增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，提升风险控制能力
添加追踪止损功能，在趋势行情中锁定浮动利润
修复源文件编码问题，将乱码注释恢复为可读的俄文或翻译为英文
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit to adapt stop distances to current market volatility
Add spread filtering and maximum open position limits to improve risk control
Implement a trailing stop feature to lock in floating profits during trending markets
Fix source file encoding issues to restore garbled comments to readable Russian or translate to English

risk_points: 固定止损1000点在低波动市场中可能过大，在高波动市场中可能过小
无持仓数量限制可能导致趋势行情中连续开仓叠加风险
默认信号K线为1（前一根已完成K线），存在信号延迟但相对可靠
依赖外部自定义指标，指标加载失败时EA仅打印日志但不提供用户友好的错误提示
risk_points_en: Fixed 1000-point stop loss may be too wide in low volatility markets and too narrow in high volatility markets
No position count limit may lead to consecutive overlapping entries during strong trends
Default SignalBar=1 uses the previous completed bar, introducing signal delay but improving reliability
Depends on external custom indicator — failure to load only prints a log without user-friendly error notification
